research_method.primary_source: Questura di Catanzaro / Polizia di Stato indexed official source
research_method.purpose: Test whether CLUSTER-SCOPE-001 recurs independently of Shatter.

outcomes.diagnostic_result: official wording reports several hundred extortion episodes against business/commercial activities but does not enumerate members; a 2005-2011 interval in the same sentence explicitly qualifies the mafia-war context and cannot be silently copied to every extortion episode

standard_findings.observation: Cluster-level sources can provide cardinality, seed/context periods, broad geography, target classes and offence families with different evidentiary scopes. A single cluster-wide date/place field would misattribute facts to unresolved members.
standard_findings.required_standard_revision: Allow source-scoped ASSERTION records whose subject may be EVENT_CLUSTER, with an explicit assertion scope distinguishing cluster context, investigation seed, all reported members, member subset, and procedural context.
standard_findings.anti_pattern: Do not add one synthetic cluster occurrence date, midpoint, representative point, or copy contextual temporal/geographic facts to every unresolved member.
standard_findings.persistence_follow_up: Canonical persistence must eventually retain cluster assertions separately from EVENT member rows; public map output must not emit cluster assertions as crime-event points.

standard_findings.observation: Facts co-located in the same sentence/source do not necessarily share the same subject scope. Perseo's 2005-2011 period cannot be automatically attached to the separately mentioned hundreds of extortion episodes.
standard_findings.required_rule: Every derived/cross-object fact must preserve the exact subject/predicate scope supported by the source.
